contexts.text: The vaunting of falsity is signified by the meretricious hire and the whoredom of Tyre (). AC 2466:11.
Knowledges, to those who are in the negative, are as meretricious hire.
They who love gains and profits not for the sake of any use...
The cupidity of profit and avarice have in them...
The profit which is devoted to the Lord () = the Knowledges of truth and good.
a. 3. Some who... had made profit by judgment...
By which they make gains or profits. AR 799.
